name: Hollis
bio: Carries three days of rations and eats them all on the flight in. Still first off the ramp.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A bearded soldier in an olive field jacket with webbing and a holster.
